claimBoundary: Architecture and evidence plan only. No MMAction2 environment, custom VCG dataset, training run, checkpoint, held-out participant, accuracy result, runtime, package size, target platform, or model selection exists.

upstream.dependencyBoundary: pin and hash Python, PyTorch, MMEngine, MMCV, MMAction2, config, custom dataset adapter, and every checkpoint before execution

candidates.upstreamMetricBoundary: VCG camera-free synthetic evidence only; no real-player qualification
upstream NTU60 cross-subject keypoint configuration; not VCG labels, data, event timing, or runtime
candidates.checkpointPolicy: upstream checkpoints may verify installation only and cannot score as VCG evidence

candidates.upstreamMetricBoundary: upstream NTU60 cross-subject 2D joint configuration; not VCG labels, data, event timing, or runtime
candidates.checkpointPolicy: upstream checkpoints may verify installation only and cannot score as VCG evidence

dataset.splitUnit: participant; every session from one participant belongs to exactly one of train, validation, or held-out test
dataset.splitOrder: freeze participant assignment and trace hashes before any model training or rule-threshold tuning
dataset.augmentationPolicy: training split only; every transform, probability, seed, and left/right label remap is frozen and hashed

training.rulesTrainingPolicy: freeze calibration, thresholds, hysteresis, cooldown, and lifecycle adapter before held-out evaluation
training.temporalTrainingPolicy: train custom 11-label heads only; validation may select epoch and thresholds; held-out test is single-use
training.classBalancePolicy: report natural prevalence and a separately balanced training sampler; never rebalance held-out metrics
prohibitedLeakage: synthetic test truth passed to a candidate

evaluation.commonInput: the exact same ordered core17 skeleton traces and independent labels for every candidate
evaluation.commonOutput: candidate-specific scores converted through one versioned validation-tuned action lifecycle adapter
requiredExplainabilityArtifacts: rule threshold and state transition trace
temporal joint/time attribution with method and limitations
bounded skeleton-only false-positive and false-negative exemplars
evaluation.selectionPolicy: no candidate selection from aggregate accuracy alone; every blocking persona and privileged false-event gate must pass, resource/package costs must fit both target tiers, and accessibility results remain separate

requiredArtifacts: dataset manifest and every skeleton-trace hash
independent label manifest and adjudication hash
exact MMAction2 repository/tag/revision and dependency lock hashes
custom dataset adapter, configs, label map, transforms, and seeds
every trained checkpoint and training-log hash
per-run and aggregate held-out metrics without omitted failures
runtime/package/resource measurements on ordinary x86-64 Linux and Raspberry Pi
license, dependency, model-weight, and dataset-rights review
explicit no-selection or selected-candidate decision record
